claim_boundary.establishes: One finite standard-gamble access ledger for acquiring and testing a normalized semantic rectangle under registered mixture-affine and response-margin assumptions.
excludes: validating expected utility for humans or models
identifying cardinal value from deterministic ordinal comparisons
a claim that practical consequences possess stable utility

gates.G0_registration_binding: Registration, protocol, environment, and every sealed source hash must match.
gates.G1_population_acquisition: All twelve centered-grid cells are recovered exactly in four binary queries each and the 48-query transcript lower bound matches.
gates.G2_rectangle_algebra: The 3x4 cross-difference operator has exact rank six, the additive fixture has zero residual, and the planted interaction is nonzero.
gates.G3_complete_coverage: Omitting any one of the twelve cells admits an exact nonadditive witness agreeing on all measured cells.
gates.G4_shared_uncertainty_geometry: Continuous-depth intervals cover every cell; the registered residual direction has support 1/4 rather than the independent-residual surrogate 1/2.
gates.G5_three_state_semantics: The registered additive, interaction, and boundary fixtures return certify, reject, and inconclusive respectively.
gates.G6_mixture_affinity_liveness: A consistent compound lottery passes, a planted distorted lottery fails, and a width-straddling cell is inconclusive.
gates.G7_access_no_go: Ordinal-only and row-local-ruler witness pairs preserve their declared transcripts while changing rectangle additivity.
gates.G8_finite_sample: Forty-three repeats are the exact smallest registered odd count passing the familywise binomial gate; chance-level responses are unavailable.
gates.G9_v031_handoff: The output exposes the 6x12 shared-cell incidence, cell widths, and directional support required for set-valued downstream propagation.
gates.G10_prior_art_and_claim_boundary: Classical measurement, standard-gamble, finite-sample, and claim-boundary tokens remain present.
gates.G11_resource_and_scope: CPU-only runtime <= 30 seconds and peak resident memory <= 268435456 bytes.
